package_metadata.purpose: Integrated Toyota Way thesis and cross-cutting principles.
package_metadata.book_title: The Toyota Way: 14 Management Principles from the World's Greatest Manufacturer, Second Edition
package_metadata.author: Jeffrey K. Liker
package_metadata.copyright_safety: Paraphrase-first; only short titles, labels, and indispensable terms retained verbatim.
package_metadata.current_practice_boundary: The book is a reasoning layer, not current evidence for regulations, software behavior, supplier performance, or actual operations.
package_metadata.repair_scope: Focused V1.1 linkage, source-specific traceability, derivation, and perishable communication-logistics polish.

core_thesis.statement: The Toyota Way is a long-term, people-centered management system in which purpose, connected process flow, developed people and partners, and scientific problem solving reinforce one another.
reasoning_model: Begin with customer and societal purpose and the whole system.
Connect work to reveal waiting, defects, overload, unevenness, and broken handoffs.
Make standards and abnormalities visible and respond rapidly.
Develop people to observe, hypothesize, test, reflect, and improve.
Align daily experimentation with long-term direction.
Adapt principles to context instead of copying Toyota artifacts.
second_edition_emphases: Scientific thinking is treated as a central hub connecting the 4P model.
Mechanistic tool deployment is contrasted with an organic learning system.
Technology should support people and processes and be tested before broad adoption.
Aligned goals, daily management, and strategy execution are connected to iterative learning.
Examples extend beyond repetitive manufacturing, while context and local learning remain essential.
non_negotiable_boundaries: Standard and actual condition before countermeasure
Respect people by improving systems and developing capability
JIT is not zero inventory ideology
Visual management is not dashboard decoration
A3 is thinking and coaching, not a form-completion exercise
Current facts and authoritative rules outrank source-era examples

core_principles.plain_language_meaning: Philosophy, process, people, and problem solving form an interdependent management system rather than a menu of tools.
operational_implications: Start from purpose and actual conditions.
Make gaps visible close to the work.
Develop people while changing the process.
Use iterative checks rather than assume implementation equals learning.
core_principles.misuse_warning: Do not convert this system principle into an isolated checklist or use it to override current evidence.
